children.value: > Fact From Story Stocks surged through the week on rising hopes that the Federal Reserve is finally done with its market-crunching hikes to interest rates, in order to get inflation under control.
> > Fact From Story A report on Friday underscored that pressure is easing on inflation after it showed employers hired fewer workers last month than economists expected.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Lower inflation is correlated with the federal reserve holding steady or decreasing interest rates.
> Commonsense Knowledge When interest rates are expected to hold steady or decrease, the stock market tends to increase.
